_comment: Default BrainCase retention policy for QuantZhai / LimbiCore agent-memory records. Policy is multi-axis: retention + tier + record_type + status are all considered. No automatic ingestion. No raw DELETE. No promotion of candidates. No model-facing prune tools. BrainCaseDB does not enforce this policy; the operator prune CLI loads and applies it. memory_domain values in rules are match strings, not registry entries.

rules.name: candidate_ephemeral_expiry
rules._comment: Unreviewed ephemeral candidates retire after 7 days.

rules.name: candidate_session_expiry
rules._comment: Unreviewed session candidates retire after 14 days.

rules.name: candidate_project_stale
rules._comment: Unreviewed project candidates surface stale-review after 14 days; retire after 60 days.

rules.name: candidate_durable_review_overdue
rules._comment: Unreviewed durable candidates surface review-overdue after 30 days. Never auto-retire: operator must explicitly act.

rules.name: active_ephemeral_expiry
rules._comment: Active ephemeral records surface stale after 48h; eligible for operator prune after 7 days.

rules.name: active_session_stale
rules._comment: Active session records surface stale after 7 days. Operator prune after 30 days (stale only; operator decides retirement).

rules.name: active_project_stale
rules._comment: Active project records surface stale-review after 90 days. No automatic retirement; operator action required.

rules.name: active_durable_keep
rules._comment: Active durable records are never auto-retired by age. Only explicit operator retire/supersede applies. This rule prevents any prune CLI from touching durable active records.
